title: DECODE-RANGE AUDIT — every ES-tuned knob in eran_agent.py judged against the rule-switch task's own scale, and measured over the SAME 24 seeds as the recorded baselines
context: Two experiments were lost to the SAME bug class: an unbounded theta squashed into a knob whose RANGE was physically unreasonable (ctx_gain caught mid-arena-run; trace_tau found in the 24-seed bimodal probe, AUC 1.00 separator). This file is the full audit the second bug demanded: all 10 knobs, judged and — where absurd — fixed in one file (arena/decode_audit.py), then re-measured on the identical protocol (12,000,000 steps/seed, half ES over 10 knobs / half online life, 24 held-out episodes from seed 7,000,000, training only ever saw seeds 0..4,000,000).
one_trial_worth_pp: same as the bimodal probe: ~0.06 pp for a fast (~1,600-trial) arm, ~0.01 pp for a timing-out (~8,000-trial) arm; seed spread, not trial count, is the real uncertainty here too, hence the same 24 seeds.

inventory.reasoning: context horizon 1/(1-lam) capped at CRIT_WINDOW=10 trials -- a leak that outlives the rule it's supposed to help recognise is not memory, it is noise smeared across a rule boundary.
unchanged: Q is hard-clipped to +/-20 elsewhere, rate<1 cannot overshoot, and AUC 0.348 on 24 seeds shows no failure mode lives here (higher eta_q trends WITH success, not failure).

value learning rate capped so its implied averaging window (1/eta_v) stays >= ~3 trials -- a value estimate that overwrites itself in 1-2 trials cannot represent 'this prototype's worth under the rule that's been live for 10'.
unchanged: this IS a probability; [0,1] is not a choice, it is the type.
unchanged: both extremes resolve within a small fraction of the 6,000,000-step online-life budget, and AUC 0.459 (24 seeds) is chance-level -- no failure mode traced here.

inventory.unit: residual exploration probability, held forever (training AND evaluation)
inventory.reasoning: capped below the CRIT_HITS/CRIT_WINDOW=8/10 hard limit (residual random actions among 3 choices make the 80% criterion mathematically unreachable once eps_floor>0.30; 0.25 keeps a margin and still clears every observed success, whose max was 0.219).

inventory.unit: multiplier on the organism's own age-graded strictness k (0.5 infant .. 3.0 adult)
inventory.reasoning: combined with the organism's own age curve (0.5..3.0) the effective sd-multiplier is capped near 4.5 instead of 9.6 -- beyond that the spawn tolerance falls below any plausible cosine similarity and the organism can never differentiate a new rule from an old one again.

eligibility horizon capped at CRIT_WINDOW=10 -- credit cannot span longer than the rule it's paying for without smearing reward across a silent rule change. AUC 1.00, 0 misclassifications on 24 held-out seeds.

inventory.unit: noradrenaline jump size per reward-prediction-error event
inventory.reasoning: unchanged: already inside the NE_MAX=3.0 architectural cap, and chemistry was measured to do nothing on this task (-2.9+/-2.2pp, indistinguishable from zero); AUC 0.422.

inventory.unit: loudness of the leaky-context block inside the L2-normalised prototype key, relative to the raw observation
inventory.reasoning: context loudness capped so it cannot out-shout the CURRENT card by more than ~1.5x its own scale -- the mirror image of the original bug (context too quiet); every observed success used <=1.354, so 3.0 is generous headroom, not a tight squeeze.

pong_alma_findings.range: [0.25, +inf) — NO upper bound at all, not even a wide one
pong_alma_findings.task_scale_reasoning: The judge's LIF chamber integrates for LIF_STEPS=6 ticks at LIF_DT=0.35 (a 2.1-time-unit budget) starting from v=0. Once threshold exceeds what that budget can reach for a plausible drive magnitude (drive is itself an unbounded amp*ctx term, but empirically O(1) near ES birth), the chamber can never spike and the judge is permanently mute — same disease as ctx_gain/trace_tau (an ES-reachable region makes the knob's own mechanism inert), just with an infinite rather than merely-too-wide ceiling.
pong_alma_findings.blast_radius: LOW / contained. The controller needs 2 of 3 judges to agree (majority quorum); one silenced judge degrades the ensemble toward the remaining 2 judges' agreement rather than causing a silent total failure the way trace_tau's 121-trial horizon did for the WHOLE agent. No documented experiment has been traced to this range; it is flagged on inspection, not from a burned run.
pong_alma_findings.action_taken: FLAGGED, NOT FIXED in this pass. pong-alma's own ES benchmark (arena.py round-robin) is a separate codebase from the eran-brain rule-switching rerun this audit was scoped to measure; changing player_beitdin.py's threshold formula would need its own re-run of arena.py to verify, which was not requested. Recommended future bound: threshold in roughly [0.25, 3-5], derived the same way trace_tau's was — from LIF_STEPS*LIF_DT and the typical drive scale.

pong_alma_findings.task_scale_reasoning: Over LIF_STEPS=6 ticks at dt=0.35, leak=0.5 leaves ~32% of a constant drive's integral after 6 ticks and leak=0.05 leaves ~90% — both are plausible integration regimes for a 6-tick window; neither extreme makes the chamber's own dynamics meaningless.
pong_alma_findings.action_taken: no issue found; not fixed, not flagged as absurd.

pong_alma_findings.range: (0, 1) — a gate, this IS its natural bound
pong_alma_findings.task_scale_reasoning: same class as eps0: the decoded quantity is itself a probability/gate; (0,1) is the type, not a choice.

pong_alma_findings.knob: raw amp / phase / action-code genes (no squash at all)
pong_alma_findings.task_scale_reasoning: These are ordinary unbounded network weights / a quantization code with fixed cutoffs (+-0.33) that is valid for ANY real input — there is no squashing EXPRESSION here to have a wrong range in the first place (unlike Dayan.threshold, which does apply a floor-plus-abs transform). Not an instance of this bug class.
pong_alma_findings.action_taken: reviewed, not applicable to this bug class.

scope_boundary: eran_agent.decode() is SHARED across all three agentic-arena tasks (DMS, RULE, PONG) — AGENTIC-ARENA-2026-08-21.json's ERAN-CTX/ERAN-TRACE/ERAN-PROTO numbers on DMS and PONG used the SAME 6 now-flagged ranges and may carry the same distortion. This audit's SPECIFIC numeric bounds, however, are derived from RuleSwitchTask's own constants (CRIT_WINDOW=10 etc.) and are NOT a drop-in fix for DMS or PONG: DMS's delay sweep runs to 16 steps, so a trace_tau capped at 10 would be actively wrong there (it would forbid exactly the credit horizon DMS at delay=16 needs); PONG has a wholly different, continuous timescale (200-2000 ticks/episode). Any decode audit for DMS or PONG needs its own task-scale re-derivation from THEIR constants, following the same METHOD as this file, not the same NUMBERS.
